title: Shifted Cosine: Period and Range
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For $y=1+\cos 3x$, find the period of oscillation and the full set of output values (the range).

steps.title: Compute the Period from the Interior Coefficient
steps.explanation: The argument $3x$ triples the cycling speed, so each wave completes in $2\pi/3$.
steps.why: Period depends only on the coefficient multiplying $x$.

steps.title: Bound the Unscaled Cosine
steps.explanation: Cosine always lives in $[-1,1]$; adding $1$ to all three parts shifts the interval to $[0,2]$.
steps.why: Vertical shifts translate the range without changing its width.

steps.title: Read Off Amplitude and Midline
steps.explanation: The curve oscillates one unit above and below the lifted midline $y=1$, touching $0$ at its troughs and $2$ at its peaks.
steps.why: Seeing the graph as a shifted unit cosine makes the range visually obvious.
